technology.value: Radiochemical gallium detector: solar neutrinos capture on 71Ga to produce 71Ge via inverse beta decay in liquid gallium metal, which is chemically extracted and counted in periodic campaigns
technology.quote: a radiochemical method based on inverse beta decay involving gallium-71 atoms and neutrinos
technology.note: Sourced from Wikipedia (rank 12) only this session. No `radiochemical` value exists in TECHNOLOGY_CLASSES; `technology_class` is set to `other`, matching the same resolution used for detector:gallex-gno.

target_mass.quote: Between 50–57 tonnes of liquid gallium metal served as the neutrino detection medium.
target_mass.note: Sourced from Wikipedia (rank 12) only this session.

summary.plain: Tonnes of liquid gallium metal, deep in a Russian mountain, that solar neutrinos occasionally turn into germanium, which scientists then extract and count.
summary.technical: Radiochemical liquid-gallium-metal detector (50-57 t), 71Ga(nu_e,e-)71Ge reaction, at Baksan; chemically extracted and counted in periodic campaigns rather than observed in real time.
